## Designer's visual verdict: the restored films are accepted

**Reviewed:** candidate `de6126dcb00fb1c7875de5396c8ab8783c55465e`, with the evidence at `e8eee333`: [the review package](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/e8eee333ea25f88c4f46c58533def56c3b587a96/docs/frontend/evidence/release-preservation-2026-11-15/README.md) and all 12 captures, at 390 × 844 and 430 × 932. Your request ([6896355659](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/pull/266#issuecomment-6896355659)) is received, and this is the review.

**Accepted:** the parts this PR changes, which are the films now playing on a Food match.

| Part | Compared with | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **role-film**, full motion | The approved role films (#198); sheet 17 at 0:26 | **Accepted.** The Doctor's panels "COLONY NINE. THE FEVER YEARS." and "TWO DOSES LEFT." are the approved film's, in the final ten seconds of reading |
| **role-film**, Reduce motion | The approved still of the Hacker's film | **Accepted.** "THE DATA DENS OF PHOBOS.", "PAID IN ADVANCE." and "KA-CHUNK", the approved panels beat |
| **boarding**, full motion | The approved boarding film; sheet 19 | **Accepted.** The crew climbing the ramp, as in the approved film's third to fifth frames |
| **boarding**, Reduce motion | The approved source, `design/pregame-films/boarding`, rendered at the same moment | **Accepted, pixel-checked.** It is the 6.86 s still, with the title the Reduce-motion version draws on every still. I rendered the approved source at that moment: at 390 × 844 it differs from the capture by a mean of about 2 levels out of 255, which is JPEG noise |

- **No sheet exception is needed:** the films and their native presentation are as accepted before ("Keep as built: … the films" in #222).
- **What I checked in the code:** this PR changes the gating only:
  - `pregame.ts`: `canPlay`, through the release registry;
  - `library.ts` and `crew-runtime.mjs`: the release dispatch.

  It does not touch `apps/game/hosted/planet/pregame.mjs` or `pregame.css`, which draw the role stage.

**Not part of this acceptance:** two parts this PR leaves unchanged still differ from the sheets. They are not regressions. They remain #222 item 6, under PHONE-PARITY:
- **role-card** (sheets 17 and 31) is still the text panel with a small portrait. The sheet draws the large illustrated card, the clock in the top bar, and "Your film starts in 0:19".
- **role-ready** (sheet 17 at 0:30): Ready looks the same before it can be used as after.
  - I measured the two captures' Ready buttons: they differ by a mean of about 1 level out of 255. The sheet dims Ready until the film ends.
  - The line "Hide your phone, then tap Ready" and Ready's check mark are also missing.

**Notes,** not blocking and unchanged by this PR:
- **The amber ring on "Skip film"** is its focus ring (`.pregame-skip:focus-visible`). The control is focused when the film's dialog opens, which is right for keyboards and screen readers.
- **Its wording:** the sheets draw Skip with the skip icon, and "Skip" for boarding. The game says "Skip film" in both, with no icon. This is for PHONE-PARITY.
- **`crew-runtime.mjs` has other users:** the room scene (#261) and the phone shell (#265) import it too. For `design-0.9.0` with the Food pins, the new resolver must still give `crewDrawing: true`. Their checks will confirm it when they take `main` after this lands.

**What I checked:**
- all 12 captures, by eye, against sheets 17 and 19 and the approved films' review sheets;
- the boarding still, pixel by pixel, against the approved source;
- the Ready buttons, by measuring them;
- the PR's diff, for what it changes.

I did not re-run the journeys. Physical phones, Safari and a connected session are untested, as the PR says.
